name: HWR_XP_ATTACHMENT_B
description: This is the table for the experience store attachments.

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_ID
columns.description: The Unique database identifier for this attachment.

columns.name: USAGE_TYPE_IRI
columns.description: The usage type iri for this attachment.

columns.name: CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: The content type of the attachment.

columns.name: CONTENT
columns.description: The content of the attachment as binary data.

columns.name: LENGTH
columns.description: The lenght in bytes of the attachment.

columns.name: SHA2
columns.description: The computed sha2 of the attachment.

columns.name: FILE_URL
columns.description: The url of the file for this attachment.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
